Resolves #318

Evidence: L2 (automated-harness: test/playwright/unit/component/GallerySortSelection.spec.mjs)

## AC Evidence
| AC | File : Line | Proof |
|---|---|---|
| `HelixModel#select(itemId)` always selects without toggling off an existing selection | `src/selection/HelixModel.mjs:265-333` | Removes the `toggleSelection=true` 2nd-parameter workaround and `isSelected` toggle branch; stores pre-registration selection via `NeoArray['add'](items, itemId)`; fixes `singleSelect` loop comparison (`item !== itemId` instead of `item.id !== itemId`); annotates `vnodeId` and adds `itemId` to `items`. |
| `HelixModel#toggleSelection(item)`, `isSelected(id)`, and `deselect(item)` resolve logical record IDs consistently | `src/selection/HelixModel.mjs:233-263` | Implements `getSelectionItemId(item)` and `isSelected(id)` on `HelixModel` so inherited `toggleSelection(item)` and `deselect(item)` resolve records, objects, and `useInternalId` keys identically to `select(itemId)`. |
| Remove legacy `, false` second argument from Covid app callers | `apps/covid/view/country/Helix.mjs:139`, `apps/sharedcovid/view/country/Helix.mjs:139` | Calls `selectionModel.select(recordId)` directly, matching `apps/covid/view/country/Gallery.mjs:117`. |

## Deltas from ticket
- **Inherited `toggleSelection` vs. custom override:** Since `selection.Model#deselect` already resolves `getItemVdomId(item)` (`#16559` / `007080c7cd`), overriding `getSelectionItemId` and `isSelected` on `HelixModel` allows the inherited `selection.Model#toggleSelection` and `deselect` to work directly without duplicating `toggleSelection`. (Note: `HelixModel#select` and `onContainerClick` fire `selectionChange` as `(items, oldItems)` while inherited `Model#deselect` fires `{selection}`; `Helix#onSelectionChange` only reads `value?.[0]`, so unifying the `selectionChange` payload shape across `GalleryModel` / `HelixModel` and `selection.Model` is a separate follow-up).
- **User-visible `onItemClick` behavior:** Because `HelixModel#onItemClick` (`src/selection/HelixModel.mjs:68-77`) delegates to `this.select(key)`, clicking an already-selected helix item now keeps it selected rather than toggling it off — matching `GalleryModel#onItemClick`, while `onContainerClick` continues to clear the selection.

## Test Evidence
- Command: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/component/ test/playwright/unit/selection/`
- Spec: `test/playwright/unit/component/GallerySortSelection.spec.mjs`

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge, non-blocking:** the model now emits two `selectionChange` payload shapes. `select` fires `(items, oldItems)`, while the inherited `deselect` (via `toggleSelection`) fires `{selection}`.
  - In-tree nothing breaks, because `Helix.onSelectionChange` reads only `value?.[0]`.
